verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṁ gahapatiṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, the Buddha said to the householder Anāthapiṇḍika:

verses.pali: “citte, gahapati, byāpanne kāyakammampi byāpannaṁ hoti, vacīkammampi byāpannaṁ hoti, manokammampi byāpannaṁ hoti.
verses.english: “Householder, when the mind is fallen, bodily, verbal, and mental deeds are fallen.

verses.pali: Tassa byāpannakāyakammantassa byāpannavacīkammantassa byāpannamanokammantassa na bhaddakaṁ maraṇaṁ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
verses.english: Someone whose deeds of body, speech, and mind are fallen will not have a good death.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, kūṭāgāre ducchanne kūṭampi byāpannaṁ hoti, gopānasiyopi byāpannā honti, bhittipi byāpannā hoti;
verses.english: It’s like a bungalow with a bad roof. The roof peak, rafters, and walls fall in.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, gahapati, citte byāpanne kāyakammampi byāpannaṁ hoti, vacīkammampi byāpannaṁ hoti, manokammampi byāpannaṁ hoti.
verses.english: In the same way, when the mind is fallen, bodily, verbal, and mental deeds are fallen.

verses.pali: Tassa byāpannakāyakammantassa byāpannavacīkammantassa byāpannamanokammantassa na bhaddakaṁ maraṇaṁ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
verses.english: Someone whose deeds of body, speech, and mind are fallen will not have a good death.

verses.pali: Citte, gahapati, abyāpanne kāyakammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti, vacīkammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti, manokammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti.
verses.english: When the mind is not fallen, bodily, verbal, and mental deeds are not fallen.

verses.pali: Tassa abyāpannakāyakammantassa abyāpannavacīkammantassa abyāpannamanokammantassa bhaddakaṁ maraṇaṁ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
verses.english: Someone whose deeds of body, speech, and mind are not fallen will have a good death.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, kūṭāgāre succhanne kūṭampi abyāpannaṁ hoti, gopānasiyopi abyāpannā honti, bhittipi abyāpannā hoti;
verses.english: It’s like a bungalow with a good roof. The roof peak, rafters, and walls are not fallen in.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, gahapati, citte abyāpanne kāyakammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti, vacīkammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti, manokammampi abyāpannaṁ hoti.
verses.english: In the same way, when the mind is not fallen, bodily, verbal, and mental deeds are not fallen.

verses.pali: Tassa abyāpannakāyakammantassa …pe… abyāpannamanokammantassa bhaddakaṁ maraṇaṁ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā”ti.
verses.english: Someone whose deeds of body, speech, and mind are not fallen will have a good death.”
